description: This is a React component implementing a tourist registration form with OTP verification and blockchain ID issuance simulation. It handles form input, OTP sending and verification, and displays registration results.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates form state with provided key and value.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, validates input, initiates email OTP sending.

methods.name: verifyEmailOTP
methods.description: Verifies entered email OTP, proceeds to send phone OTP upon success.

methods.name: verifyPhoneOTP
methods.description: Verifies entered phone OTP, completes registration and displays results.
